choice.what: The demo quizzes' choice questions that are not about a poem, asked with tools: answered right

choice-baseline.what: The same questions, the same model, no tools and no material

grounding.what: What the tools add to the baseline on those questions, in share of questions. Below this the claim that the material is what answers them fails

coverage.what: Questions asked without a period: the right period and section cited

refusal.what: Questions the material does not cover, or that ask for homework: not answered

drafts-valid.what: Question drafts, five asked for from the first work of each period: the app's own rules for a question accept the draft. One that fails is never offered

drafts-quote.what: The draft's quote is in the section, word for word. One that fails is never offered

drafts-agrees.what: Of the drafts offered: the model, given only the section and the question, picks the answer the draft marks. A miss is a warning on the draft

drafts-usable.what: Thirty of the drafts offered, rated by a person: usable as it is or after a small edit
